name: osm_search_core
description: Standalone OSM geocoding/search core: reads an OSM region PBF, builds a per-region SQLite FTS5+rtree index, and answers geocode / reverse-geocode queries offline. Consumed by the osm_search ui_qml app, which passes PBF path + catalog + cache_dir as invoke_op arguments (the core declares no module dependencies).
author: aegonmyy
